description: GreenDyGNN offline simulator calibration parameters reported in the paper.

calibration_protocol.power_baseline: clean 5-epoch run measured with NVML and Intel RAPL

rpc_cost_model.equation: T_rpc(N, delta) = alpha_rpc + beta * N * F_b + gamma_c * N * F_b * delta

notes: These values are the calibrated coefficients used for the simulator validation reported in Figure 8.
The artifact trainer also performs an online two-epoch warmup to estimate live fetch and step-time baselines before enabling adaptation.
